audit.whatIsWrong: The stored chart gave Vayne Levels 1-3, 6 and 2+ items with 2/10 ratings, while the packet chart and every whys line said the lane swings to Ornn from Level 3 through the first item.
audit.why: 51-52% Ornn win rate over 2716 games plus whys[2]-[5] ('finally let you trade back', 'you own the 6 all-in', 'durable bully') all disagree with a chart that hands Vayne everything.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 realigned to the packet chart (Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn) in both layers, ratings raised to match; Vayne keeps Level 1 and 2+ items.

audit.why: Four spikes read correctly: Vayne early, Ornn at 3 with Bellows Breath, Ornn at 6, Vayne once Silver Bolts scales.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn was described only as 'wall-stun' with no cooldown, and 'Silver Bolt' was written singular.
audit.why: Condemn (E) is 20/18/16/14/12s at 550 range: it knocks back always but only stuns on terrain collision, so open ground removes the stun entirely. Tumble (Q) is 6/5/4/3/2s. Final Hour is 100/85/70s and grants invisibility during Tumble. The W is Silver Bolts.
audit.corrected: Named abilities correctly and keyed advice to Condemn's 20s rank-1 cooldown and the terrain requirement.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere in the cooldown breakdown.
audit.why: Condemn at 20s rank 1 is the punishable window; Tumble drops to 2s at rank 5.

audit.whatIsWrong: Several strings claim Ornn's W gives a shield.
audit.why: Riot's text for Bellows Breath says only that Ornn advances breathing fire and applies Brittle — no shield is described.
audit.corrected: Removed the shield claim from whys[2]; other instances flagged in notes rather than rewritten.

edits.before: You have no shield, no combo and no mana at level 1 — Vayne's tumble-empowered autos and Silver Bolt procs poke you freely while you just farm.
edits.after: You have no shield, no combo and no mana at level 1 — Vayne's Tumble-empowered autos and Silver Bolts procs poke you freely while you just farm.

edits.before: W (Bellows Breath) comes up — its unstoppable percent-HP exhale and shield finally let you trade back through her tumble kite.
edits.after: Bellows Breath comes up on a 12s cooldown — the Brittle it applies finally lets your autos trade back through her Tumble kite.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Condemn (E): 20s at rank 1 — it knocks you back always but stuns only into terrain, so fight in the open. - Tumble (Q): 6s early, 2s maxed. - Final Hour: 100s of invisible Tumbles.

edits.before: Track Vayne's Condemn: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. When it is down — W-E + R her.
edits.after: Condemn (E), 20s: the stun only lands if terrain is behind you — never fight beside a wall.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Condemn is 20s at rank 1 — stand clear of walls, then engage.

edits.before: Vayne wastes Condemn — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Condemn whiffed — 20 seconds of no escape, so commit now.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her Tumble is 2s maxed — chasing in the open just feeds free procs.

notes: Several strings (spikes[1].text, early, wants.you[0], breakdown lines) describe Ornn's W as giving a shield and being 'unstoppable'. Riot's Data Dragon text states neither, so they were left as-is rather than repeated or asserted against; recorded in unverified. Ornn's own E knockup requires terrain, which pairs with his Q pillar — that is already stated correctly.
